name: lt-eli-mcp
description: Lithuanian legislation with verifiable citations, from the Register of Legal Acts (TAR) through the official open-data API (data.gov.lt): search acts, fetch an act's metadata and its text, with the TAR code and a link to e-tar.lt. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to data.gov.lt; nothing goes to MateMatic.
